R.priority.summary_it: Relevance to applicable objectives and priorities

programme_evidence.statement: the proposal is relevant for objectives and priorities of the Action

R.values.summary_it: EU values ​​​​​​​​​​and non-discrimination integrated into the project

programme_evidence.statement: the proposal is relevant for the respect and promotion of shared EU values

R.profile.summary_it: Profile, activities and experience relevant to the sector

programme_evidence.statement: the profile, experience and activities of the participating organizations are relevant for the field of the application

R.needs.summary_it: Authentic and adequate analysis of needs

programme_evidence.statement: the proposal is based on a genuine and adequate needs analysis

R.synergy.summary_it: Synergies between sectors or strong potential impact in one or more sectors

programme_evidence.statement: the proposal is suitable for creating synergies between different fields of education, training, youth and sport or it has potentially a strong impact on one or more of those fields

R.innovation.summary_it: Innovation related to the sector or context

programme_evidence.statement: the proposal is innovative

R.complementarity.summary_it: Complementarity and added value compared to existing initiatives

programme_evidence.statement: the proposal is complementary to other initiatives already carried out by the participating organisations

R.eu.summary_it: European added value necessary for results

programme_evidence.statement: the proposal brings added value at EU level through results that would not be achieved by activities carried out in a single country
the project objectives are clearly defined, realistic and address the needs and goals of the participating organizations and the needs of their target groups
the proposed methodology is clear, adequate and feasible

D.plan.summary_it: Complete work plan and coherent phases

programme_evidence.statement: the project work plan is clear, complete and effective, including appropriate phases for preparation, implementation and sharing project results

D.cost.summary_it: Cost-effectiveness and adequate resources for activities

programme_evidence.statement: the project is cost-effective and allocates appropriate resources to each activity

D.qa.summary_it: Quality control, monitoring and evaluation with timely corrections

programme_evidence.statement: the project proposes appropriate quality control, monitoring and evaluation measures to ensure that the project implementation is of high quality, completed in time and on budget
the activities are designed in an accessible and inclusive way and are open to people with fewer opportunities

D.digital.summary_it: Digital tools and learning integrated with activities and collaboration

programme_evidence.statement: the project incorporates the use of digital tools and learning methods to complement their physical activities, and to improve the cooperation between partner organisations
The project is designed in an eco-friendly way and incorporates green practices in different project phases
The project encourages participation and civic engagement

D.indicators.summary_it: Realistic and useful qualitative and quantitative indicators

programme_evidence.statement: The project clearly describes both qualitative and quantitative indicators, that are realistic, feasible, and contribute to strengthening the overall quality of the project

D.learningfit.summary_it: If learning activities are foreseen: adequate profiles and numbers

programme_evidence.statement: the extent to which these activities are appropriate for the project's objectives and involve the appropriate profile and number of participants

D.learningpractical.summary_it: If learning activities are foreseen: agreements and quality practical support

programme_evidence.statement: the quality of practical arrangements, management and support modalities in learning, teaching and training activities

D.recognition.summary_it: If foreseen learning outcomes: recognition consistent with the sector

programme_evidence.statement: the quality of arrangements for the recognition and validation of participants' learning outcomes, in line with European transparency and recognition tools and principles

P.mix.summary_it: Mix of partners, capabilities and complementarity

programme_evidence.statement: the project involves an appropriate mix of participating organizations in terms of profile, including grassroots organizations, past experience in the Program and expertise to successfully complete all project objectives

P.newcomers.summary_it: Significant involvement of newcomers and less experienced organizations

programme_evidence.statement: the project involves newcomers and less experienced organizations to the Action

P.tasks.summary_it: Roles and tasks demonstrate active contribution

programme_evidence.statement: the proposed allocation of tasks demonstrates the commitment and active contribution of all participating organisations
the proposal includes effective mechanisms for coordination and communication between the participating organisations, as well as with other relevant stakeholders

P.third.summary_it: When relevant: essential added value of the non-associated partner

programme_evidence.statement: If applicable, the extent to which the involvement of a participating organization from a third country not associated with the Program brings an essential added value to the project

I.integration.summary_it: Integration of results into ordinary work

programme_evidence.statement: the project proposal includes concrete and logical steps to integrate the project results into the regular work of participating organisations

I.direct.summary_it: Positive impact on participants, organizations and communities

programme_evidence.statement: the project has the potential to positively impact its participants and participating organisations, as well as their wider communities

I.wider.summary_it: Use of results outside the partnership and beyond the project

programme_evidence.statement: the expected project results have the potential to be used outside the organizations participating in the project during and after the project lifetime, and at local, regional, national or European level

I.dissemination.summary_it: Targeted dissemination, use and recognition of EU funding

programme_evidence.statement: the project proposal includes concrete and effective steps to make the results of the project known within the participating organisations, to share the results with other organizations and the public, and to publicly acknowledge the European Union funding

I.open.summary_it: When relevant: open access and licensing without disproportionate limits

programme_evidence.statement: if relevant, the extent to which the proposal describes how the materials, documents and media produced will be made freely available and promoted through open licences, and does not contain disproportionate limitations

I.sustain.summary_it: Sustainability and continuity after the EU contribution

programme_evidence.statement: the project proposal includes concrete and effective steps to ensure the sustainability of the project, its capacity to continue having an impact and producing results after the EU grant has been used up

T57R1C1 and T115R1C1 deny/relativize the management cap and suggest shares above 20%; Programme2026 p243 and expert p49 establish a maximum of 20%. Keep conflict, discard suggested tolerances.
T33 brand SCH/VET/ADU not updated; Program references pages200–206 are historical. ScreenshotP214 contains old examples, not priorities to apply2026.
The template includes WP2–WP6, five implementation WPs; Program p243 recommends a maximum of four. Do not convert the recommendation into a ban.
T74/T84/T94/T104 report All activities in WP2 also in sections WP3–WP6: avoid verbatim copying.
P377 and P382 both use BOX IMPLEMENTATION-07 for participation and amount management. The stable IDs of the JSON are distinct.
T7 and copies indicate financial manager mandatory for coordinators: statement of the form, not official verified obligation of the form.
The eight annexes are editorial playbooks: mandatory, upload possibility and unproven limits. They do not replace answers in the form.
Youth17–24, focus groups/hackathons, past cooperation and GDPR commitments are examples or model sentences; they do not describe the user's project.
The KA220-x form and expert guidance from national agencies do not authorize automatic transfer to ESC, Sport EACEA or other centralized calls.
